verdict.overall: No Sunday baseline exists for any name tonight, and the previous-day comparison shows everything flat on price and score, so nothing has shifted confidence either way yet. GOOGL, NVDA and AMAT look the calmest, best-defined ranges for swing trades, while TSLA, PLTR and APP show options leaning against further upside across most of the next month. The main things to watch are AVGO's earnings on 12-09 landing inside this window, and unusually busy options trading today in SPY, QQQ and NVDA, which makes their nearest magnet levels less reliable for now.

tickers.TSLA: No Sunday baseline. Price 380.14, mixed trend. Options lean against a rally most weeks with magnets (367.5-378) sitting below price, range roughly 350 floor to 410-420 ceiling. Today's options trading is unusually busy (2.1x normal) in a large chain, so the near magnet still carries weight.
tickers.PLTR: No Sunday baseline. Price 163.59, downtrend. Options lean against a bounce across all four weeks, with magnets (140-160) sitting below price and a broad range between a 140-155 floor and 175-185 ceiling.
tickers.NVDA: No Sunday baseline. Price 149.30, downtrend but MACD turning up. The nearest week actually supports a push toward 150, though today's options trading is unusually busy (2.9x normal) so treat that pull with caution; later weeks turn neutral with a wide 130-170 range, all cheaply priced.
tickers.ZETA: No Sunday baseline. Price 31.97, downtrend. Mostly neutral with a tight 29-36 range, only turning against further downside in the final week (30-35 range); the far-dated setup rests on a thin options chain.
tickers.AMAT: No Sunday baseline. Price 311.18, downtrend. Neutral across all four weeks with magnets well above price (327.5-380), giving a fairly wide drifting-up range between a 275-310 floor and up to a 352.5 ceiling.
tickers.AVGO: No Sunday baseline. Price 300.86, downtrend. Earnings land 2026-12-09, inside this window, adding event risk. Otherwise neutral throughout with a steady 260-340 range and magnets drifting up toward 320-340.
tickers.GOOGL: No Sunday baseline. Price 273.10, downtrend but MACD turning up. Neutral and cheaply priced across all four weeks with a well-defined 265-310 range and magnets clustered at 280-290, one of the calmer setups on the board.
tickers.APP: No Sunday baseline. Price 378.95, uptrend but MACD turning down. Options lean against further gains most weeks, with magnets (350-370) sitting below price and a range between 332.5 and 420, narrowing to 360-400 by mid-December.
tickers.BE: No Sunday baseline. Price 152.89, downtrend. Neutral setup, but magnets keep climbing further out (162.5 up to 200) against a tighter 150-170 floor-ceiling range, making this a choppier one to watch rather than trade tightly.
tickers.SPY: No Sunday baseline. Price 716.70, downtrend. Neutral throughout the window, but today's options trading is unusually busy (4.79x normal), making the nearest magnet (721, about £105.29) less reliable; broad range from a £102-£103 floor to a £113-£117 ceiling further out.
tickers.QQQ: No Sunday baseline. Price 633.93, downtrend. Neutral throughout, with unusually busy options trading today (3.18x normal) weakening confidence in the nearest magnet (644, roughly £73.35); rough range £66.74-£77.28 over the month, since ISUS only partly tracks the Nasdaq.
